annotations.title: Wikipedia + Wikidata topic lookup: summary, coordinates, image, key facts, any language

description: Use when an agent needs a quick, cited fact sheet on a place, organization, thing or concept. Input: q (topic or title), optional lang (Wikipedia code; default: the query's script, e.g. Hangul → ko, Latin → en). Output: JSON title, description, extract, coordinates, thumbnail, page URL, Wikidata facts (instance of, inception, country, official website), CC BY-SA attribution. Best title match if not exact. Use instead: web_answer for a current question from the live web. Example: ?q=Seoul&lang=en Price: $0.005 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

lang.description: Wikipedia language code (default: from the query script, Hangul → ko, kana → ja, Latin → en; e.g. ko, ja, de, zh, simple)

name: knowledge_wiki
